rule.message:
Admission to the full major status program is determined by a competitive holistic review, which includes an interview, GPA, and a portfolio review after completion of pre-major coursework.
All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s Liberal Education requirements .
At least 18 credits upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View a sample plan for this major here: https://sampleplan.umn.edu/node/161 Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
